query: with lesson_rows as (select ch.title as chapter_title,ch.display_order as chapter_order,l.id as lesson_id,l.title as lesson_title,l.display_order as lesson_order,coalesce(length(l.content),0) as content_length,l.is_active,(select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=l.id) as exercise_count,(select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=l.id) as quiz_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters ch on ch.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=ch.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series se on se.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and lv.name='Terminale' and se.name='C' order by ch.display_order,l.display_order limit 200), citation_rows as (select s.name as subject_name,c.id,c.author,ct.theme from public.citations c join public.subjects s on s.id=c.subject_id left join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id=c.id where s.name in ('Français','Philosophie','Histoire-Géographie','Physique-Chimie') order by s.name,c.created_at limit 500), per_theme as (select subject_name,theme,count(*) as citation_count from citation_rows group by subject_name,theme), citation_summary as (select cr.subject_name,count(distinct cr.id) as citation_count,count(distinct cr.author) as author_count,count(distinct cr.theme) as theme_count,min(pt.citation_count) as per_theme_min,max(pt.citation_count) as per_theme_max from citation_rows cr left join per_theme pt on pt.subject_name=cr.subject_name and pt.theme=cr.theme group by cr.subject_name) select json_build_object('lessons',(select coalesce(json_agg(lesson_rows),'[]'::json) from lesson_rows),'citation_summary',(select coalesce(json_agg(citation_summary),'[]'::json) from citation_summary));
